recipes.policy: Explicit refresh; source manifest locks exact bytes. Each HTTP response retained with acquisition receipt.
Query-defined snapshot, with raw responses and statement metadata. A later live query is a new snapshot.
Select a release commit, retain ZIP and safe extraction. Lock content hashes; never choose by directory sort.
Retain original dump and companion checksum/metadata files through the same acquirer.
Exports to a workspace; dump/Lua/exporter/dependency hashes recorded. Review and explicitly select a new immutable artifact before rebuilding consumers.

Page titles of the terms a Wiktextract dump cites, by the same Wiktionary dump's Language:stripDiacritics. Use the dump, Wiktextract output and language export of one date. Exports to a workspace with a receipt; adopt and select in the etymology_graph workflow.
Source choice must identify the publication analysis and table; legacy CSV upstream identity unresolved.
Capture https://kaikki.org/dictionary/rawdata.html with the acquirer too. The live URL cannot promise historical redownload; keep original bytes.
Domain retrieval retains documents and datasets; new dataset HTTP responses use the same artifact acquirer. Bibliographic IDs do not establish file-level reproducibility.

Use the model, revision and per-file hashes in embedding-model.json. Retain downloaded artifacts and restore their source bytes to the matching Hugging Face snapshots/<revision>/<filename> path before graph execution. The workflow verifies all three files before processing.
